name: Mandy, Indiana (UK)
description:
On URGH, Mandy, Indiana is a force of uncanny nature, grafting together a record that is as much a call to action as a parlay into oblivion and transcendence. Following their acclaimed 2023 debut, i’ve seen a way, URGH finds the band expanding their far-reaching sound with each member - vocalist Valentine Caulfield, guitarist and producer Scott Fair, synth player Simon Catling, and drummer Alex Macdougall - actively taking part in the songwriting process. Across ten tracks, Mandy, Indiana interpolate their own unconventional language into a mantra for self-determination and resilience, forging a template for a brighter future before it fades to black.

URGH is deeply personal, yet also reflects the violent, fractured state of the wider world as Caulfield’s lyrics grapple with assault, systemic indifference, and the omnipresence of pain. While most of the lyrics are in her native French, the emotional clarity cuts through regardless of language. Caulfield still uses her voice as a distorted instrument and a weapon, oscillating between equal parts playful and eviscerating, showcased on today’s single, “Magazine.” The throbbing siren-sound of the song finds the band garnering drama from the juxtaposition of quiet moments and explosive commotion as Caufield sings in French: “Abandon / All hope / Because tonight / I’m coming for you.” The accompanying visualiser was directed by  Stephen Agnew.

Commenting on the song, Caulfield explains: “‘Magazine’ is the expression of the frustration and deep-seated violence I felt while attempting to recover from being raped. Just like most victims of sexual assault, I will never get justice, and just like most perpetrators, my attacker will never be punished. My therapist encouraged me to channel my anger into something productive, so here it is: my primal, screaming call for retribution. It is the only way I will ever get to say to my rapist: you hurt me, so I’m going to hurt you.”

For Mandy, Indiana, the truth is the only way through. In 2025, the ability to make art that is seen and heard is its own form of protest, and directly addressing these issues is its own reclamation of power and strength in solidarity. URGH is a cathartic first step toward healing and a refusal to let the conversation die.

name: ABCITOO
description:
ABCITOO, from Trillegården in western Aarhus, represents the new sound of the neighborhood. He has released more than 15 singles in just two and a half years, as well as a full-length album with SPEEDY – and he’s still only a teenager, balancing school and a part-time job alongside his music career.

The young singer and rapper from Trillegården has already made his mark with tracks like “Ikk’ sig selv”, “Humble”, “Fugle”, and especially “Daydate” (feat. Stepz) and “I Like 2 Move It” (feat. Xabski). Through his music, he tells his own story and brings the streets of Aarhus V to life with authentic lyrics and a unique musicality and rhythm – something he credits his mother for inspiring.

In February 2025, ABCITOO released the album Flyvende på Life together with SPEEDY – 12 tracks in a distinctive yet genre-blending universe of trap, hip hop, pop, and R&B, colored by both optimism and melancholy. The album took the duo on a nationwide tour in April with eleven shows across Denmark.

After touring with SPEEDY in spring 2025, ABCITOO is now ready to stand on his own. Over the next six months, he’ll release a series of singles leading up to his first solo album in March 2026. The concert at Musikcaféen is a rare opportunity to experience both new material and the songs that have already made him one of the most exciting young voices in Danish music.

Get ready for a night of uncompromising energy, powerful beats, and lyrics that hit right where they matter most.

name: Dybt Overfladisk – et musikalsk standup-show om 90'erne
description:
På Islands Brygges brosten startede et venskab og et musikalsk eventyr, som ingen af de unge talenter Axel Boisen og Lars Juhl kunne have forudset. I et lille studie i et gammelt pakhus på Bryggen skabte de Axel Boys Quartet, der med humoristiske og frække fortolkninger af tidens nordiske hits fik international opmærksomhed. Publikum i både Asien og Europa tog imod numrene, og bandet røg foran store navne som Madonna, U2 og Spice Girls på hitlisterne.

I showet Dybt Overfladisk inviterer Axel og Lars publikum med tilbage til den tid, hvor Norden blev moderne, og hvor musik som Saturday Night, Dub-I-Dub, It Must Have Been Love, Scatman og Nothing Else Matters satte stemningen – også her på Bryggen. Gennem musik, billeder, tv-indslag og historier fortæller Axel om de år, hvor alt gik stærkt, og om det øjeblik, hvor livet pludselig stoppede. Et uventet hjertestop blev vendepunktet, der fik ham til at genbesøge 90’ernes glitrende facade og spørge: Hvad betød den tid egentlig for os – og hvem blev vi efter den?

Nu vender Axel og Lars tilbage til udgangspunktet på Islands Brygge med et show, der både rører, underholder og giver plads til nostalgiens fællesskab. Dybt Overfladisk spiller den 18. april 2026 som en del af forårets turné.

name: Dupont
description:
Dupont is in the midst of a significant transformation. After several years as a band, the project has returned to its roots: one person, one voice, and a deep desire to create music that feels authentic. On stage, you meet Mikkel, the songwriter behind Dupont, who won DR’s KarriereKanonen in 2024 and now continues solo.

The concert offers new songs as well as the stories behind them – including the single Night Terrors, written in just ten minutes as a direct cry for help and a reminder that music can be a refuge, a language and a form of therapy.

Dupont began in Skive as a solo project, and that space for immersion and vulnerability shapes the musical direction you can experience now. Mikkel shares the process, the change and the ambition to create a space where the audience can listen, feel and be surprised.

name: THE SWAMP
description:
Gæstespil af Kassandra Production: Kassandra Production


THE SWAMP er en immersiv performanceinstallation om internettets faldgruber, og den manipulation og vold, der foregår under radaren på det mørke internet.

Vi bruger mere og mere tid på internettet, sidder online i timevis og lever en stor del af vores sociale liv i et virtuelt univers. Hvilken indflydelse har det på os? Hvordan bliver vi påvirket og manipuleret? Og hvilke narrativer er det, der får os suget ind i den mørke del af det digitale univers, med de konsekvenser det har – personligt og samfundsmæssigt?

Du bliver inviteret ind i en dragende, mystisk og vildtvoksende sump. På vejen mister du retningssansen, og må derfor tage del i ansvaret for den videre vej gennem sumpen. Men hvem beslutter spillets regler? Og er det overhovedet et spil, eller er det den barske virkelighed?



★★★★★ The Swamp – forunderligt fluorescerende performanceinstallation
The Swamp er en velfungerende, publikumsinddragende performanceinstallation, der på tankevækkende vis sætter spot på den skræmmende virkelighed, der hersker i det grødede, menneskeskabte pløre, vi normalt kalder for Internettet.
– Iscene

Idé, iscenesættelse og medvirkende: Annika B. Lewis og Helene Kvint
Performere: Magnus Kongsgaard og Nina Tind Jensen
Scenograf: Signe Krogh
Lysdesign: Morten Ladefoged
Musik: Jens Mønsted
Dramaturg: Daniel Wedel
Foto: Jens Peter Engedal
PR: Jakob D. A. Nicolaisen
Videotrailer: Christoffer Brekne
Producenter: Ann-Jette Caron og Albert Bendix

Støttet af Statens Kunstfond

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/events/812506734688128

THE SWAMP er en pågående publikumsinvolverende installations performance der omhandler vold og manipulation på Internettet.

name: Grarup Allstars
description:
Med DMA-prisen for Årets Blues Live cementerede Grarup Allstars deres position som et band i absolut topklasse – også langt ud over bluesgenren. Anmeldere og publikum fremhæver igen og igen bandets evne til at skabe koncerter, der både bevæger og begejstrer.

Grarup Allstars er et rendyrket live-band, hvor musikken får lov til at leve i nuet. Her er der plads til spontanitet, samspil og fordybelse, og koncerten udvikler sig i takt med stemningen i rummet. Resultatet er en intens og helstøbt oplevelse, som hver gang føles unik.

På scenen står nogle af landets mest markante musikere: soulsaxofonist Niels Mathiasen, kendt fra blandt andet Gnags og Poul Krebs, guitarist Uffe Steen, bassist Niels Nello Mogensen, trommeslager Esben Bach og organist Rasmus Stenholm. I front står Margrete Grarup med en vokal, der balancerer råstyrke, nerve og musikalitet på fornem vis.

Bandets liveudgivelser That’s What Love Can Do – Live og Steamrolling Live vidner om et orkester i konstant bevægelse og med et ekstraordinært sammenspil. Publikum og anmeldere beskriver koncerterne som gåsehudsfremkaldende, euforiske og musikalsk overbevisende – en helhedsoplevelse, der sætter sig fast længe efter sidste tone.

Kl. 20.00 / Dørene åbner kl. 19.30

Support: Deliluh (CA/DK)

Continuing their streak of bending against convention, Deliluh has unveiled their newest work, ‘AUX Angel’; a heavy knock at the door of avant-rock music by two dead-eyed outliers. The self-recorded, self-produced, self-released statement lands its blows with purpose and conviction. What's rendered by the Canadian/ Danish duo is a no-frills world of darkly lit adventure, incarnated last year by a sharp physical release of letterpress postcards.

After having traded jaywalking through inner-city Toronto for train-hopping between Berlin and Marseille months prior to lockdown, Deliluh emerged in 2022 distilled down to it’s two founding members with ‘Fault Lines’, a record documenting their transition from a four-piece noise-punk firebrand to a lawless rock anomaly with a bottomless appetite. Now, after two years away from touring, their recalibration has arrived aptly explored, setting a steady course for their homespun experimentations, while spitting on the shoes of complacency and the status-quo.
